description: Find census places and CBSAs (metro areas) by case-insensitive literal name substring in the 2021 FCC geography lookup. Keep ambiguous matches distinct and choose the geography_type and geography_id to pass to fcc_get_coverage_summary. Include a location qualifier in name to narrow results; CBSA codes do not encode state membership. Always queries live FCC Open Data, even with the Form 477 mirror enabled, and needs no BDC credentials. Follow nextOffset until absent; no total match count is computed.

geography_type.description: Limit to place or cbsa; omit or leave blank to search both.

name.description: Nonblank literal name fragment, such as "Casper, WY". Apostrophes, percent signs and underscores are literal characters.

offset.description: Zero-based match offset; start at 0, then use nextOffset.

name: fcc_search_geographies

count.description: Number of matches on this page, not a total.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

geographies.description: Distinct named matches ordered by name, type, and GEOID.

name.description: Name as recorded in the FCC lookup.

nextOffset.description: Offset for the next page; absent on a final or empty page.

notice.description: Empty-page guidance or notice that more matches remain.

truncated.description: More matches remain after this page.

title: Search Geographies
